summary.business_type: Health & Fitness Calculator / Publisher (YMYL) — free calculators + dietitian-reviewed blog
top_findings: CRITICAL: Live site serves stale build — homepage and 22 other pages emit canonical http://localhost:4321 (homepage, /about/, /contact/, /blog/, /calculators/, /nutrition/, /compare/, 3 blog posts + locale variants). dist/dist2 built with wrong site config; dist3 is correct.
CRITICAL: Soft-404s — Cloudflare SPA fallback '/* /index.html 200' returns HTTP 200 with homepage content for any missing URL; /calculators/weight-loss/from-120-to-114/ is a phantom page.

HIGH: robots.txt Cloudflare-managed block disallows GPTBot, ClaudeBot, Google-Extended, CCBot, Bytespider, Amazonbot, Applebot-Extended, meta-externalagent before the site's Allow groups — AI crawlers remain blocked, contradicting ai.txt.
HIGH: Index bloat — 13,832 of 14,350 sitemap URLs are programmatic BMI/from-to-weight pages with no quality gate.
HIGH: Homepage duplicate JSON-LD (2x Organization, 2x FAQPage, 2x WebApplication) risks rich-result suppression.
HIGH: Weak visible E-E-A-T — no author byline, no last-updated, only 2 references in flagship blog article.
HIGH: Mobile homepage LCP 4.7s (lab) fails Core Web Vitals; 92-95 resources, 22-44s networkidle from Ezoic/AdSense/GA/Clarity/Ahrefs.
MEDIUM: OG tags missing on 475/500 pages; 328 titles >60 chars; sitemap lastmod static (2026-07-30).
HIGH: /zh/ pages avg ~70 words; en-gb/ca/au/nz homepages ~80% duplicate of US.
quick_wins: Rebuild with current config and redeploy dist3; purge Cloudflare cache; verify homepage canonical is https://www.weightlosspercentage.com/.
Move AI-crawler Allow groups above the Cloudflare-managed robots block to unblock GPTBot/ClaudeBot/Google-Extended.
Add visible author byline, review date, and references section to blog articles.
Emit default OG/Twitter tags on every template (missing on 475/500 pages).

categories.name: Technical SEO
what_works: Clean single-host redirection (http 301, non-www 301, trailing slash 308)
All 120 sampled sitemap URLs return 200
HSTS preload, nosniff, frame-options, referrer-policy headers
HTTP/3 + Brotli via Cloudflare

findings.title: Localhost canonical on 23 pages incl. homepage (stale deploy)
findings.description: Live curl of / and /about/ shows rel=canonical http://localhost:4321/... and og:url localhost. dist/ and dist2/ were built with site http://localhost:4321; dist3 (current source) is correct. Homepage, /about/, /contact/, /blog/, /calculators/, /nutrition/, /compare/, /blog/postpartum-weight-loss-safe-guide/, /blog/water-fasting-weight-loss/, /blog/weight-loss-plateau/, /calculators/weight-loss/from-120-to-114/ and locale variants affected.
findings.recommendation: Rebuild (npm run build -> dist3), redeploy from dist3, purge CDN cache. Verify homepage canonical is https://www.weightlosspercentage.com/.

findings.title: Soft-404s from SPA fallback
findings.description: Nonexistent URL returns HTTP 200 with homepage content via '/* /index.html 200' in _redirects. /calculators/weight-loss/from-120-to-114/ is a phantom page serving the homepage template.
findings.recommendation: Change catch-all to '/* /index.html 404' or a real 404 page; keep 200 fallbacks only for locale SPA entry points.

findings.title: No Content-Security-Policy; Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *
findings.description: Security headers otherwise strong but no CSP and a wildcard CORS header on HTML responses.
findings.recommendation: Add CSP for known third parties (Ezoic, AdSense, GTM/GA4, Clarity, Ahrefs, fonts, Unsplash); remove wildcard ACAO.

findings.title: Sitemap lastmod static; coverage gaps
findings.description: All 9 sitemaps report lastmod 2026-07-30 regardless of content. /blog/anti-gravity-exercises-weight-loss/ not in sitemaps; phantom from-120-to-114 listed.
findings.recommendation: Regenerate lastmod from file mtime on each deploy; add missing article; drop phantom URLs.

categories.name: Content Quality
what_works: Blog avg ~1,012 words; calculator pages avg ~816 words
Global Medical Disclaimer block on every page
Article schema declares clinical author (Dr. Sarah Jenkins)
Unique titles across crawled pages

findings.title: Weak visible E-E-A-T signals (YMYL health)
findings.description: Flagship article /blog/how-to-calculate-weight-loss-percentage/ has no meta author, no visible byline, no last-updated date, only 2 external references, no in-article disclaimer.
findings.recommendation: Add author byline + bio link, reviewed/last-updated line, and a Sources section with primary citations (CDC/WHO/NIH).

findings.title: Thin localized pages (zh avg 70 words)
findings.description: /zh/privacy/ 47w, /zh/terms/ 47w, /zh/about/ 49w, /zh/calculators/ 59w. /ru/ avg 299w, /uk/ avg 288w.
findings.recommendation: Translate fully or noindex thin locale stubs.

findings.title: Near-duplicate English locales
findings.description: UK/CA/AU/NZ homepages are 80.3-80.6% similar to US (sequence ratio); only re-spelling, not local content.
findings.recommendation: Add genuinely localized content (NHS/Health Canada guidance, local units) to differentiate.

findings.title: 123/500 pages under 300 words
findings.description: 24.6% of crawled pages are thin (legal pages excluded, but locale + some calculator/category pages affected).
findings.recommendation: Expand or merge; prioritize zh/ru stubs.

categories.name: On-Page SEO
what_works: 0 missing H1, 0 multiple H1, 0 missing meta descriptions, 0 noindex
Hreflang tags with return links present on all sampled pages
Meta descriptions on all 500 pages

findings.title: 23 broken canonicals (localhost)
findings.description: Inherits Technical critical finding; canonical correctness is an on-page factor.
findings.recommendation: Resolve via redeploy (Technical C1).

findings.title: Title length issues
findings.description: 328 pages >60 chars (truncation), 78 pages <30 chars. Examples: 'Calorie Deficit Calculator - Find Your Exact Daily Target (Free 2026)'.
findings.recommendation: Target 50-60 chars, keyword front-loaded, remove dated promo strings.

findings.title: OG tags missing on 475/500 pages
findings.description: og:title/og:description/og:url present only on homepage and /about/; blog, calculators and locale pages lack them.
findings.recommendation: Emit SEO.astro OG/Twitter defaults on every template.

findings.title: 25 meta descriptions under 50 chars
findings.description: Mostly legal pages; verify no truncation artifacts.
findings.recommendation: Expand where warranted.

categories.name: Schema / Structured Data
what_works: Organization (462), BreadcrumbList (229), FAQPage (154), WebApplication (137), Article (83), MedicalWebPage (83), HowTo (73), Person (92)
Detailed Article blocks (author, publisher+logo, dates, mainEntityOfPage)
All blocks valid JSON-LD

findings.title: Duplicated JSON-LD on homepage
findings.description: Homepage emits 2x Organization, 2x FAQPage, 2x WebApplication (identical). 90 pages emit >=6 schema blocks. Cause: parser_v2.ts does not strip JSON-LD from parsed head.
findings.recommendation: Strip JSON-LD in parser_v2.ts (like canonical) or stop double-injecting; emit a single @graph.

findings.title: Missing WebSite/SearchAction; brand inconsistency
findings.description: No WebSite schema; author Person never linked via worksFor; 'WeightLossPercentage.com' vs 'Weight Loss Percentage' naming mismatch.
findings.recommendation: Add WebSite+SearchAction; unify brand; add Person.worksFor/url.

findings.title: Schema opportunities unused
findings.description: Glossary (DefinedTermSet), compare pages (FAQPage/Article), nutrition (NutritionInformation) missing.
findings.recommendation: Add as content ships.

categories.name: Performance (CWV)
what_works: Blog post mobile LCP 1.6s, desktop 1.2s (good)
BMI calculator mobile LCP 1.1s (good)
Desktop homepage LCP 884ms

findings.title: Homepage mobile LCP 4.7s (fails threshold)
findings.description: Playwright lab: mobile LCP 4,732ms vs 2,500ms threshold; CLS 0.078 'needs improvement'; 43.8s networkidle.
findings.recommendation: Preload LCP, gate layout spinner, lazy-load ads/consent, defer/self-host fonts, inline critical CSS.

findings.title: Third-party script bloat
findings.description: 92-95 resources and up to 877KB transfer on homepage (Ezoic, AdSense, GTM/GA4, Clarity, Ahrefs, fonts).
findings.recommendation: Restrict ads to content pages; lazy-load third-party; remove unused analytics.

findings.title: Render-blocking CSS/fonts; no LCP preload
findings.description: Synchronous Google Fonts stylesheet in head; full-viewport white loader on every visit.
findings.recommendation: Inline critical CSS; font-display swap; remove/gate the loader.

categories.name: AI Search Readiness
what_works: High-quality llms.txt (manifest, licensing, formulas, AI permission)
Excellent ai.txt (citation rules, per-calculator accuracy references)
Static JS-free content; no paywall; strong schema
PerplexityBot/ChatGPT-User/Gemini/cohere/OMgili allowed

findings.title: robots.txt blocks major AI crawlers
findings.description: Cloudflare-managed block (GPTBot, ClaudeBot, Google-Extended, CCBot, Bytespider, Amazonbot, Applebot-Extended, meta-externalagent) precedes custom Allow groups; first-match wins so they stay blocked despite ai.txt claiming permission.
findings.recommendation: Move AI crawler Allow groups above the Cloudflare block or remove them from the managed list.

findings.title: Localhost canonical poisons citations
findings.description: Citable URLs resolve to http://localhost:4321 until redeploy.
findings.recommendation: Redeploy (Technical C1).

findings.title: Thin locales not citable; placeholder contact
findings.description: zh/ru pages too thin for AI grounding; en locales near-duplicate. ai.txt contact is a placeholder.
findings.recommendation: Improve locale content; use a real contact email.

categories.name: Images
what_works: 0 missing alt text across 500 pages
og:image 1200x630 + twitter card on homepage
Complete favicon set + manifest

findings.title: OG image/tags missing on 475/500 pages
findings.description: Social cards on blog/calculators/locales are bare.
findings.recommendation: Emit default OG/Twitter tags sitewide.

findings.title: No WebP/AVIF strategy; some imgs lack dimensions
findings.description: Unsplash images via URL params; add width/height and lazy loading.
findings.recommendation: Serve WebP/AVIF with explicit dimensions.
